contents.DefaultText:
Hello everyone!

Today we're introducing some performance improvements, some new items and some bug fixes!

<size=150%>New Content:</size>

<size=125%>Tallow Candles:</size>
You can now make candles with fat and twine. They last considerably longer than torches and are relatively cheap to make.

<size=125%>Soap:</size>
Soap and Lye have also made a return. You can make lye by boiling ash water and use it to craft soap. Soap is a very efficient way to wash yourself and a pretty good disinfectant.

<size=125%>Salves:</size>
You can now also make salves (Healing and Soothing), which are stronger than ointments, but are crafted using fat.


And now to the patch notes proper:

<size=150%>Version EA_0.29:</size>

- Performance Improvements (ticks in the late game should have significantly less lag).
- Added Tallow Candles, Lye, Soap, Healing and Soothing Salves (as well as their art) and the Tallow Crafts quest for the Quest Mode.
- Improved the birch sap system to make the creation of syrup and wine more realitic.
- Fixed a bug which sometimes prevent players from chopping a log into Pieces.
- Fixed a bug which was preventing the Tar from heating inside Campfires and Ovens.
- Fixed another bug which would spawn a duplicate Waterfall at Greenfalls.
- Gathering Mud from the Pond now completes Basic Pottery "Gather Mud" subquest.
- Killing a Wolf using a Log Trap now properly reduces Wolf population.
- Fixed a bug which allowed the player to place more Log Chairs in Mudhut than intended.
- Snow inside liquid containers will now melt if put inside a warmed up Kiln.
- Various text and Art fixes.

That's all for now!
See you on the next announcement. :)
contents.Text:
大家好！

今天我们带来了一些性能优化、新物品和bug修复！

<size=150%>新内容：</size>

<size=125%>脂肪蜡烛：</size>

现在您可以用脂肪和细线制作蜡烛。它们的使用时长比火把长得多，而且制作成本相对较低。

<size=125%>肥皂：</size>

肥皂和碱液也回归了。您可以通过煮沸灰水来制作碱液，再它来制作肥皂。肥皂是一种高效的清洗方式，也是一种非常好的消毒剂。

<size=125%>药膏：</size>
现在您还可以制作药膏（治疗和舒止痛），它们比软膏更有效，但使用脂肪制作而成。


现在来看看更新日志：

<size=150%>版本 EA_0.29：</size>

- 性能优化（游戏后期每一tick的延迟应该会显著减少）。
- 添加了脂肪蜡烛、碱液、肥皂、治疗和止痛药膏（以及它们的艺术品）以及任务模式的脂肪工艺任务。
- 改进了白桦树汁系统，使糖浆和白桦酒的制作更加逼真。
- 修复了一个有时阻止玩家将原木砍成块的bug。
- 修复了一个阻止焦油在营火和烤箱内加热的bug。
- 修复了另一个会在绿色瀑布处产生重复瀑布的bug。
- 从池塘收集泥巴现在可以完成基础陶器的“收集泥巴”子任务。
- 使用原木陷阱杀死狼时会正常地减少狼的数量了。 
- 修复了一个允许玩家在泥屋中放置比预期更多的原木椅的bug。
- 现在将容器中的雪放入预热好的窑中时雪会融化了。
- 修复了各种文本和美术。

目前就这些了！
下次见。:)
